【最终结果（result 阶段，已执行分析脚本）】

(a) 两个子集的统计量（筛选：project ∈ {ee, rpp} 且 drop==False）：

| 项目 | n | 均值(页) | 标准差 | 中位数 | 范围 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Experimental Economics (ee) | 18 | **28.00** | 7.37 | 27.5 | 16–45 |
| Psychology (rpp) | 90 | **11.00** | 6.16 | 9.0 | 1–31 |

倍数关系：28.0 / 11.0 ≈ **2.55 倍**。

(b) 最终自然语言假设（hypothesis）：
"The average length of original papers in Experimental Economics is about 28 pages (n=18, SD≈7.4, median 27.5), whereas in Psychology it is about 11 pages (n=90, SD≈6.2, median 9.0). Original papers in the Experimental Economics replication project are therefore roughly 2.5 times longer than those in the Psychology replication project."

(c) Workflow 描述（见 payload.workflow）。

敏感性检查（Psychology 均值）：主口径 11.000（90 行）；剔除完全重复记录 rpp.149 后 11.045（89 行）；按唯一 title 计 88 篇为 11.011；若不剔除 drop=True 为 11.217（97 行）。各口径差异 <0.25 页，结论稳健。数据质量：length 全表 0 缺失、0 零值；ee/rpp 无整行重复；aggregated 在 ee/rpp 中全为 NaN（无聚合行干扰）。

payload.hypothesis: The average length of original papers in Experimental Economics is about 28 pages (n=18, SD≈7.4, median 27.5, range 16–45), whereas in Psychology it is about 11 pages (n=90, SD≈6.2, median 9.0, range 1–31). Original papers in the Experimental Economics replication project are therefore roughly 2.5 times (28/11 ≈ 2.55) longer than those in the Psychology replication project.
payload.workflow: Data source: meta-regression_study_data_heterogeneity_in_replication_projects.csv (927 rows; the only file containing 'length' = pages of original paper; project mapping ee=Experimental Economics, rpp=Psychology per schema, cross-validated against the second dataset which has 18 'Experimental Economics' rows and no length column). Filters: project in {ee, rpp}; drop==False (7 rpp rows flagged for data quality, e.g. rpp.46 with n.o=230025). Computed mean/SD/median/min/max of 'length' per project: EE n=18 mean=28.00 (SD 7.37, median 27.5); Psychology n=90 mean=11.00 (SD 6.16, median 9.0); ratio 2.545. Sensitivity: dropping the exact duplicate record rpp.149 gives 11.045 (n=89); unique original papers by title gives 11.011 (n=88); keeping drop==True rows gives 11.217 (n=97) — all within 11.0–11.2, so the conclusion is robust. No missing or zero length values; no aggregated rows in ee/rpp (aggregated is NaN there).
